chapter: Drum sets, small bands and the depression
title: Fifteen-piece Desvigne band and the shift to small combos
summary: Desvigne's band had fifteen pieces; after leaving, Jackson played mostly five-piece groups.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Did you ever play in any smaller bands? I know you say you worked in a lot of different bands and all too. Aside from the bigger band, Sidney Desvinge's band, how many pieces was it? About ten or twelve or something? Sidney's band?
Yeah. Sidney had fifteen pieces. Fifteen piece.
Fifteen that band. I don't remember that band. You were a big band then, wasn't it? Fifteen piece band.

And I left them that, after the big band went out, they started hitting a lot of small combos. Well, that was from three to five pieces. Yeah. I played it from three to five pieces after I left Sidney's band. And that's about what I've been playing ever since I've been playing. Since I left the band, big band. I played a six piece band like this, five pieces, or a seven piece band. But most of the time it would be five musicians. Yeah. Most of the small bands are made up of five musicians.
